['Electronic-Partner Handel SE '].company_description: ElectronicPartner Handel SE is a company that operates in the consumer electronics trading business. The company aims to label particularly sustainable products and expand its range with a focus on sustainability. Matthias Assmann was appointed as a member of the board with effect from January 1, 2023.

['Outokumpu Nirosta GmbH '].company_description: Outokumpu Nirosta GmbH is a stainless steel producer based in Germany. The company has been streamlining its operations, including divesting certain operations in Germany and completing expansion projects at its Krefeld plant. Outokumpu aims to strengthen its competitiveness in Europe through these restructuring efforts.
